title: Configuration Key Collision due to Schemaless Key-Value Bags
pattern: Representing entity configurations as un-typed, schemaless key-value dictionaries attached to domain aggregates.
why_bad: Allows spelling mistakes in configuration keys to compile and execute without errors. It relies on runtime string lookups that fail silently when keys are missing, returning invalid default states.
detection: The widespread utilization of string-keyed maps (such as `HashMap<String, String>`) to control active execution behaviors or domain policies.
fix: Expose configurations as strongly typed, domain-specific structures verified by the compiler at compile time.
source: Marianne Bellotti - *Kill It with Fire* (2021, No Starch Press).pdf, Chapter 3.
